name_reason: Name already follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), domain 'vga', descriptor 'palette_data_ptr' accurately reflects a pointer (uint32 BSS slot) to the VGA palette buffer. No Ghidra address residue in the name; the _ptr suffix correctly reflects the pointer data type. Verified by readers fd2_set_vga_palette_range / _with_add / fd2_interpolate_palette_range_toward_color (index ptr[idx*3+component]) and writers in main/load-save/cinematic paths.
purpose: Base pointer (uint32 BSS slot) holding the address of the loaded VGA palette buffer; source colours for every DAC palette write (fade/flash/tint).
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS pointer slot at 0x53A65. Initialized from FDOTHER.DAT resource index 0 (the 768-byte standard VGA palette = 256 entries x 3 RGB bytes, 6-bit DAC values 0..0x3F). Read by the palette-write primitives, indexed as ptr[idx*3 + component], to fetch the base colour before darken/brighten/interpolate then OUT to VGA DAC ports 0x3C8/0x3C9. Reloaded (free-then-load) on new-game / continue / load paths (fd2_load_save_and_init_engine, main). Cinematic/ending code (fd2_play_ending_and_record_clear, aniend) reassigns it to other FDOTHER.DAT palettes per scene; some paths save the previous pointer and restore it afterward.
datatype: uint32 (4-byte pointer slot; holds address of an unsigned char[768] palette buffer)
element_semantics: Pointed-at buffer = 256 palette entries x 3 contiguous RGB bytes (768 bytes total); each byte is a 6-bit VGA DAC value 0..0x3F. Accessed as ptr[paletteIndex*3 + 0/1/2] for R/G/B.
comment_original_issue: Existing comment was accurate and concise but did not state the pointed-at buffer's internal layout (768 bytes = 256 entries x 3 RGB bytes, 6-bit DAC values, indexed ptr[idx*3+component]) -- the load-bearing fact for understanding how the palette primitives use it.
notes: Data address (not a function) so get_plate_comment/set_plate_comment MCP do not apply; plate read/created via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism (setComment returns void in this Ghidra build, called without bool assignment). Live primary symbol confirmed = data_fd2_vga_palette_data_ptr (USER_DEFINED). Memory at 0x53A65 is all zero (BSS), consistent with a runtime-initialized pointer.
